title.rendered: Save the Date:  Kindergarten Open House – March 6th 3:30-6:00

content.rendered: March 6th from 3:30-6:00 pm all Sherwood Elementary Schools will be hosting their Kindergarten Open House.  We welcome all parents and their future students to visit our school anytime between 3:30 -6:00 to tour the school, meet the principal and kindergarten teachers, take a short bus ride and learn more about what to expert for your incoming kindergartner.  Registration packets will be available in our office beginning Tuesday, January 22nd for the 2019-2020 school year.  Required to complete enrollment you will need two forms of proof of residence and immunization records. Birth certificates will be accepted as well.  Students must be 5 years old on or before September 1st, 2019.  If you need more information, please contact Beccah Wagner, our Family Resource Coordinator at 503-825-5486 or email her at rwagner@sherwood.k12.or.us  You are welcome to call our office as well at 503-825-5300 or stop by.
